_note: An employer's car (owned or hired) used partly for official duties and partly privately, the employer meeting its running and maintenance, engine not over 1.6 litres: a fixed amount per calendar month (D-113; rulebook PERQ-CAR-*). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.15(3) Table II Sl. 1(c)(i) column C, "₹ 5000" (Gazette 271092, p.1542). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(2) Table II Sl. (1)(c)(i), "Rs. 1,800" (consolidated rule 3, p.2). The chauffeur's add-on is PERQ-CAR-CHAUFFEUR. Also the amount an employee's own car's expenditure is reduced by (Sl. 2(b)), and the one car valued at this row where several are provided (r.15(3)(b); r.3(2) proviso). Every regime: a perquisite is salary. Valued only for a specified employee (D-113 C1a, OQ-10); MotorCarPerquisite in PerquisiteNode applies it.
